questions: Are your eyes moving involuntarily, without you intentionally looking from side to side?
Do you see the world wobble or move when this happens?
Have these eye movements started recently or become worse suddenly?
Do you have double vision or blurred vision during the episodes?
Do the episodes occur continuously, even when you try to keep your eyes still?
Do you experience dizziness, spinning, nausea, or problems with balance?
Do you have a new or severe headache?
Have you noticed weakness, numbness, facial drooping, trouble speaking, or difficulty walking?
Have you had any recent head injury, ear infection, or significant illness?
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed any medications or recreational drugs?
Have you ever had similar eye movements before?
Do you have a history of eye disease, neurologic disease, seizures, or multiple sclerosis?
